reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the redline is identical to the original with no comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

Section 18.9 is mutual and includes the M&A/successor carve-out permitting assignment without consent to an acquirer of substantially all business or assets, and affiliate assignment with consent 'not to be unreasonably withheld or delayed' — squarely at or above the ASSIGN fallback (mutual successor assignment plus reasonableness standard for other assignments).

No Vendor/Array right to terminate, re-price or restrict on a Change in Control of the Customer (Ono) appears; Section 18.10 imposes firewall obligations only on an Array Acquirer, so walk-away territory is not implicated and there is no 'deemed assignment' trigger.

Shortfalls from preferred (consent required for affiliate assignment, tax-consequence proviso, no express competitor bar on Array assignments) are correctly noted in the rationale rather than redlined, consistent with the playbook's minor sub-element rule.
Deterministic check confirming the successor/affiliate carve-out is satisfied corroborates the classification.
